scope: Empty-server install simulated in a local virtual machine, not a real server. A disposable Fedora 44 Cloud Base VM (4 vCPU, 6 GiB, 60 GB virtio disk, user-mode network) booted from the stock image with a cloud-init seed; a clean clone of main; the one-command acceptance with --install-unit and --first-project; then a guest reboot. Not public networking, not a public certificate, not sustained load.

reboot.detail: guest rebooted; sbarbase.service active and the console published its address on the first probe; the environment's Auth and REST were running again

defects_found_and_fixed.defect: acceptance ran the console serving check before anything was built (503 on every page, then a crash before evidence)
block IO limits named the partition /dev/vda3; the kernel's io.max takes whole disks only, so the database container never started (Docker exit 125)
preflight required 8 cores (message said 7) by summing CPU ceilings against cores
preflight required the full 5888 MiB split placement plus reserve on an empty host
a failed first launch was reported as a retained source to adopt
every body-less POST or DELETE got a body over the real listener, so key issuance and revocation answered 400
the console port was ephemeral at every start, which breaks a TLS proxy after a restart
the 1.7 GB image pull ran under a 600 s command timeout with no progress output
the runtime refused to start below a fixed 6 GiB even after the preflight admitted the host
an environment could pass its admission and leave the service unable to restart after a reboot

earlier_run: A first VM (8 vCPU, 10.5 GiB) found the first seven defects in order and passed 12 of 12 plus 13 of 13 once they were fixed; its evidence is superseded by this run.
